pr_body:
#### What is it?
- [ ] Bugfix (user facing)
- [x] Feature (user facing)
- [ ] Codebase improvement (dev facing)
- [ ] Meta improvement to the project (dev facing)

#### Description of the changes in your PR
- pauses video player when internet disconnects with ERROR_CODE_IO_NETWORK_CONNECTION_FAILED
- disables error notification setting isCatchableException = true
- adds toast method to error util
- modifies play() to prepare() video if video is not prepared

#### Before/After Screenshots/Screen Record
- Before: 
![NewPipeError](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/115518657/198860240-96410bf5-cd10-455b-9f31-86cec2dc34a6.png)

![NewPipeErrorMessage](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/115518657/198859962-3937c34c-d355-484f-9eb6-b9a9ffb45f9d.png)

- After: 
![NewPipeNetworkToast](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/115518657/198859966-6249837a-623c-49b2-92be-a89714143605.png)

#### Fixes the following issue(s)
- Fixes #8898


#### APK testing
The APK can be found by going to the "Checks" tab below the title. On the left pane, click on "CI", scroll down to "artifacts" and click "app" to download the zip file which contains the debug APK of this PR.

#### Due diligence
- [x] I read the [contribution guidelines](https://github.com/TeamNewPipe/NewPipe/blob/HEAD/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md).
pr_title: Pause player on internet disconnect and show toast

There should be an option whether to pause player or not. Suppose you have an unstable/poor network connection then it will be really annoying to see the player paused every now and then having to click the play button manually.

> There should be an option 

Or, depending on what the timeout value is, the player could be set to pause just a little before that duration is completed, and keep trying to load until then.

review_comment:
As you can see on [the JavaDoc of the error code](https://exoplayer.dev/doc/reference/com/google/android/exoplayer2/PlaybackException.html#ERROR_CODE_IO_NETWORK_CONNECTION_FAILED), using this error and show to the user that it doesn't have a connection in this case is not appropriate for all cases.

I recommend checking the network connection using the system APIs / compat/JetPack APIs if there are ones instead.
You must create a string ressource and reference it here, to allow translation of this message.
